note: Edit this file to manage the bookshelf. Links are direct product URLs taken from about.html. links.extra adds more buttons (e.g. another edition). Set flipkart to "none" when a book is not sold there (the button is hidden). Leave a link empty until you have it: Amazon and Flipkart then fall back to a store search for the title, Pothi shows 'link soon'. cover.image (optional) is a cover picture path. To add sample chapters, create books/samples/<id>.json as {"chapters":[{"title":"Chapter 1","text":["Paragraph one."]}]} and the Read sample button appears by itself.
